#!/usr/bin/env python3
import os
import sys
import time
import hashlib

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
from sklearn.ensemble import HistGradientBoostingClassifier

START = time.time()


def _fsync_dir(path="."):
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY)
    try:
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


def _atomic_write_bytes(data, path):
    tmp_path = path + ".tmp"
    with open(tmp_path, "wb") as f:
        f.write(data)
        f.flush()
        os.fsync(f.fileno())
    os.replace(tmp_path, path)
    _fsync_dir(".")


def _group_mode(s):
    if s.notna().any():
        return s.value_counts().idxmax()
    return np.nan


def _build_features(train_path="data/train.csv", test_path="data/test.csv"):
    train = pd.read_csv(train_path)
    test = pd.read_csv(test_path)

    n_train = len(train)
    test_ids = test["PassengerId"].values
    y = train["Transported"].astype(int).values

    df = pd.concat(
        [train.drop(columns=["Transported"]), test], axis=0, ignore_index=True
    )

    # Missing-value indicators
    df["Age_missing"] = df["Age"].isna().astype(int)
    df["HomePlanet_missing"] = df["HomePlanet"].isna().astype(int)
    df["Destination_missing"] = df["Destination"].isna().astype(int)
    df["CryoSleep_missing"] = df["CryoSleep"].isna().astype(int)
    df["VIP_missing"] = df["VIP"].isna().astype(int)
    df["CabinMissing"] = df["Cabin"].isna().astype(int)

    amt_cols = ["RoomService", "FoodCourt", "ShoppingMall", "Spa", "VRDeck"]
    for c in amt_cols:
        df[c + "_missing"] = df[c].isna().astype(int)

    # Passenger / group identifiers
    gid = df["PassengerId"].str.split("_", expand=True)
    df["GroupId"] = gid[0]
    df["PassengerInGroup"] = gid[1].astype(int)
    df["GroupSize"] = df.groupby("GroupId")["PassengerId"].transform("size")
    df["IsGroupLeader"] = (df["PassengerInGroup"] == 1).astype(int)

    # Name-derived frequencies
    names = df["Name"].fillna("Unknown").astype(str)
    name_parts = names.str.split()
    df["FirstName"] = name_parts.str[0]
    df["Surname"] = name_parts.str[-1]
    df["NameLength"] = names.str.len()
    df["FirstNameFreq"] = df.groupby("FirstName")["PassengerId"].transform("size")
    df["SurnameFreq"] = df.groupby("Surname")["PassengerId"].transform("size")

    # Cabin features
    df["CabinFreq"] = df.groupby(df["Cabin"].fillna("Unknown"))[
        "PassengerId"
    ].transform("size")
    cabin_split = (
        df["Cabin"].fillna("Unknown/Unknown/Unknown").str.split("/", expand=True)
    )
    df["Deck"] = cabin_split[0]
    df["CabinNum"] = pd.to_numeric(cabin_split[1], errors="coerce")
    df["Side"] = cabin_split[2]

    # Spending features
    for c in amt_cols:
        df[c] = df[c].fillna(0)

    df["TotalSpend"] = df[amt_cols].sum(axis=1)
    df["SpendCount"] = (df[amt_cols] > 0).sum(axis=1)
    df["LogTotalSpend"] = np.log1p(df["TotalSpend"])
    df["SpendPerPerson"] = df["TotalSpend"] / df["GroupSize"].clip(lower=1)

    # Booleans are stored as object with True/False/nan; convert safely
    df["CryoSleep"] = (
        df["CryoSleep"]
        .fillna(False)
        .astype(str)
        .str.strip()
        .str.lower()
        .isin(["true", "1"])
        .astype(int)
    )
    df["VIP"] = (
        df["VIP"]
        .fillna(False)
        .astype(str)
        .str.strip()
        .str.lower()
        .isin(["true", "1"])
        .astype(int)
    )
    df["CryoSpendMismatch"] = ((df["CryoSleep"] == 1) & (df["TotalSpend"] > 0)).astype(
        int
    )

    # Group-mode categorical features and imputation
    home_mode = df.groupby("GroupId")["HomePlanet"].transform(lambda x: _group_mode(x))
    df["GroupMode_HomePlanet"] = home_mode.fillna("Unknown")
    df["HomePlanet"] = df["HomePlanet"].fillna(home_mode).fillna("Unknown")

    dest_mode = df.groupby("GroupId")["Destination"].transform(lambda x: _group_mode(x))
    df["GroupMode_Destination"] = dest_mode.fillna("Unknown")
    df["Destination"] = df["Destination"].fillna(dest_mode).fillna("Unknown")

    deck_for_mode = df["Deck"].replace("Unknown", np.nan)
    deck_mode = deck_for_mode.groupby(df["GroupId"]).transform(lambda x: _group_mode(x))
    df["GroupMode_Deck"] = deck_mode.fillna("Unknown")
    df["Deck"] = (
        df["Deck"]
        .replace("Unknown", np.nan)
        .fillna(deck_mode.replace("Unknown", np.nan))
        .fillna("Unknown")
    )

    side_for_mode = df["Side"].replace("Unknown", np.nan)
    side_mode = side_for_mode.groupby(df["GroupId"]).transform(lambda x: _group_mode(x))
    df["GroupMode_Side"] = side_mode.fillna("Unknown")
    df["Side"] = (
        df["Side"]
        .replace("Unknown", np.nan)
        .fillna(side_mode.replace("Unknown", np.nan))
        .fillna("Unknown")
    )

    # Age imputation with group mean
    age_group_mean = df.groupby("GroupId")["Age"].transform("mean")
    age_median = df["Age"].median()
    df["Age"] = df["Age"].fillna(age_group_mean).fillna(age_median)

    # Cabin number imputation with group mean
    cabin_num_group_mean = df.groupby("GroupId")["CabinNum"].transform("mean")
    df["CabinNum"] = df["CabinNum"].fillna(cabin_num_group_mean).fillna(-1)
    df["GroupMean_CabinNum"] = cabin_num_group_mean.fillna(-1)

    # Numeric group aggregates
    group_numerics = [
        "Age",
        "TotalSpend",
        "LogTotalSpend",
        "RoomService",
        "FoodCourt",
        "ShoppingMall",
        "Spa",
        "VRDeck",
    ]
    for col in group_numerics:
        df[f"GroupMean_{col}"] = df.groupby("GroupId")[col].transform("mean")
        df[f"GroupMax_{col}"] = df.groupby("GroupId")[col].transform("max")

    df["GroupCryoMean"] = df.groupby("GroupId")["CryoSleep"].transform("mean")
    df["GroupVIPMean"] = df.groupby("GroupId")["VIP"].transform("mean")
    df["GroupSpendCountMean"] = df.groupby("GroupId")["SpendCount"].transform("mean")

    df["DeckFreq"] = df.groupby("Deck")["PassengerId"].transform("size")
    df["SideFreq"] = df.groupby("Side")["PassengerId"].transform("size")

    # One-hot encode low-cardinality nominal features
    cat_cols = [
        "HomePlanet",
        "Destination",
        "Deck",
        "Side",
        "GroupMode_HomePlanet",
        "GroupMode_Destination",
        "GroupMode_Deck",
        "GroupMode_Side",
    ]
    df = pd.get_dummies(df, columns=cat_cols, prefix_sep="_")

    drop_cols = [
        "PassengerId",
        "GroupId",
        "Name",
        "FirstName",
        "Surname",
        "Cabin",
        "Cabin_raw",
    ]
    drop_cols = [c for c in drop_cols if c in df.columns]

    features = [c for c in df.columns if c not in drop_cols]

    # Safety: any remaining object column must become numeric
    for c in features:
        if df[c].dtype == object:
            df[c] = pd.factorize(df[c])[0]

    X = df[features].astype(np.float32)
    X_train = X.iloc[:n_train].reset_index(drop=True)
    X_test = X.iloc[n_train:].reset_index(drop=True)

    return X_train, X_test, y, test_ids


def _train_probe(X_train, y, X_test):
    params = {
        "objective": "binary",
        "metric": "binary_logloss",
        "learning_rate": 0.1,
        "num_leaves": 7,
        "max_depth": 2,
        "verbosity": -1,
        "num_threads": 6,
        "seed": 42,
    }
    d_all = lgb.Dataset(X_train, y)
    model = lgb.train(params, d_all, num_boost_round=50)
    return model.predict(X_test)


def _run_full_candidate(X_train, y, X_test):
    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
    oof_lgb = np.zeros(len(X_train))
    oof_hgb = np.zeros(len(X_train))
    best_iters = []

    lgb_params = {
        "objective": "binary",
        "metric": "binary_logloss",
        "learning_rate": 0.05,
        "num_leaves": 31,
        "min_child_samples": 20,
        "feature_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_freq": 1,
        "lambda_l1": 0.1,
        "lambda_l2": 1.0,
        "verbosity": -1,
        "num_threads": 6,
        "seed": 42,
    }
    hgb_params = {
        "max_iter": 300,
        "learning_rate": 0.05,
        "max_leaf_nodes": 31,
        "min_samples_leaf": 20,
        "l2_regularization": 0.1,
        "early_stopping": False,
        "random_state": 42,
    }

    for tr_idx, va_idx in skf.split(X_train, y):
        X_tr = X_train.iloc[tr_idx]
        X_va = X_train.iloc[va_idx]
        y_tr = y[tr_idx]
        y_va = y[va_idx]

        dtr = lgb.Dataset(X_tr, y_tr)
        dva = lgb.Dataset(X_va, y_va, reference=dtr)
        lgb_model = lgb.train(
            lgb_params,
            dtr,
            num_boost_round=1500,
            valid_sets=[dva],
            callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(50, verbose=False), lgb.log_evaluation(0)],
        )
        oof_lgb[va_idx] = lgb_model.predict(
            X_va, num_iteration=lgb_model.best_iteration
        )
        best_iters.append(lgb_model.best_iteration)

        hgb_model = HistGradientBoostingClassifier(**hgb_params)
        hgb_model.fit(X_tr, y_tr)
        oof_hgb[va_idx] = hgb_model.predict_proba(X_va)[:, 1]

    oof_ens = 0.5 * oof_lgb + 0.5 * oof_hgb
    val_score = accuracy_score(y, (oof_ens > 0.5).astype(int))

    # Final full-data models
    final_iter = int(np.mean(best_iters))
    lgb_full = lgb.train(
        lgb_params, lgb.Dataset(X_train, y), num_boost_round=final_iter
    )
    hgb_full = HistGradientBoostingClassifier(**hgb_params)
    hgb_full.fit(X_train, y)

    test_pred_lgb = lgb_full.predict(X_test, num_iteration=final_iter)
    test_pred_hgb = hgb_full.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
    test_pred = 0.5 * test_pred_lgb + 0.5 * test_pred_hgb

    return test_pred, val_score


def main():
    X_train, X_test, y, test_ids = _build_features()

    # Cheap candidate-specific probe
    probe_pred = _train_probe(X_train, y, X_test)
    probe_sub = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "PassengerId": test_ids,
            "Transported": probe_pred > 0.5,
        }
    )
    probe_bytes = probe_sub.to_csv(index=False).encode("utf-8")
    _atomic_write_bytes(probe_bytes, "candidate_probe.csv")
    _atomic_write_bytes(probe_bytes, "submission.csv")

    elapsed_probe = time.time() - START
    sha_probe = hashlib.sha256(probe_bytes).hexdigest()
    print(f"CANDIDATE_PROBE_READY elapsed_s={elapsed_probe:.2f} sha256={sha_probe}")
    sys.stdout.flush()

    # Full candidate
    test_pred, val_score = _run_full_candidate(X_train, y, X_test)
    sub = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "PassengerId": test_ids,
            "Transported": test_pred > 0.5,
        }
    )
    sub_bytes = sub.to_csv(index=False).encode("utf-8")
    _atomic_write_bytes(sub_bytes, "submission.csv")

    elapsed_full = time.time() - START
    sha_full = hashlib.sha256(sub_bytes).hexdigest()
    print(f"FULL_CANDIDATE_READY elapsed_s={elapsed_full:.2f} sha256={sha_full}")
    print(f"FINAL_VALIDATION_SCORE: {val_score:.4f}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import os
import re
import sys
import time
import random
import hashlib
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from torch.utils.data import TensorDataset, DataLoader
from torch.nn.utils.rnn import pack_padded_sequence, pad_packed_sequence
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from collections import Counter

START = time.time()
SEED = 42
MAX_CHARS = 200
BATCH_SIZE = 128
EPOCHS = 2
LR = 1e-3
CHAR_DIM = 32
WORD_DIM = 128
HIDDEN_DIM = 128
SENT_DIM = 16
POS_DIM = 16
DROPOUT = 0.3
VOCAB_MAX = 50000

DATA_DIR = "data"
TRAIN_CSV = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "train.csv")
TEST_CSV = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "test.csv")

device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
torch.set_num_threads(6)
torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = True


def set_seed(seed=SEED):
    random.seed(seed)
    np.random.seed(seed)
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)


def sha256_file(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()


def atomic_write_bytes(data, path):
    tmp = path + ".tmp"
    with open(tmp, "wb") as f:
        f.write(data)
        f.flush()
        os.fsync(f.fileno())
    os.replace(tmp, path)
    try:
        dir_fd = os.open(".", os.O_DIRECTORY)
        os.fsync(dir_fd)
        os.close(dir_fd)
    except Exception:
        pass


def atomic_write_df(df, path):
    tmp = path + ".tmp"
    df.to_csv(tmp, index=False)
    with open(tmp, "ab") as f:
        f.flush()
        os.fsync(f.fileno())
    os.replace(tmp, path)
    try:
        dir_fd = os.open(".", os.O_DIRECTORY)
        os.fsync(dir_fd)
        os.close(dir_fd)
    except Exception:
        pass


class CharSpanTagger(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, char_vocab_size, word_vocab_size, n_sentiments=3):
        super().__init__()
        self.char_embed = nn.Embedding(char_vocab_size, CHAR_DIM, padding_idx=0)
        self.word_embed = nn.Embedding(word_vocab_size, WORD_DIM, padding_idx=0)
        self.sent_embed = nn.Embedding(n_sentiments, SENT_DIM)
        self.pos_embed = nn.Embedding(MAX_CHARS, POS_DIM)
        lstm_input = CHAR_DIM + WORD_DIM + SENT_DIM + POS_DIM
        self.lstm = nn.LSTM(
            lstm_input,
            HIDDEN_DIM,
            num_layers=1,
            batch_first=True,
            bidirectional=True,
        )
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(DROPOUT)
        self.fc = nn.Linear(HIDDEN_DIM * 2, 1)

    def forward(self, char_ids, word_ids, sent_ids, pos_ids):
        xc = self.char_embed(char_ids)
        xw = self.word_embed(word_ids)
        xs = self.sent_embed(sent_ids).unsqueeze(1)
        xp = self.pos_embed(pos_ids)
        x = torch.cat([xc, xw, xs.expand(-1, char_ids.size(1), -1), xp], dim=-1)

        lengths = (char_ids != 0).sum(dim=1).long().cpu()
        lengths_sorted, perm = lengths.sort(descending=True)
        perm = perm.to(x.device)
        x_sorted = x[perm]
        packed_x = pack_padded_sequence(
            x_sorted, lengths_sorted, batch_first=True, enforce_sorted=True
        )
        packed_out, _ = self.lstm(packed_x)
        out, _ = pad_packed_sequence(
            packed_out, batch_first=True, total_length=char_ids.size(1)
        )
        out = out[perm.argsort()]

        logits = self.fc(self.dropout(out)).squeeze(-1)
        return logits


def select_span(logits):
    n = len(logits)
    if n == 0:
        return 0, -1

    best = -1e30
    cur = 0.0
    start = 0
    best_start = 0
    best_end = -1

    for r in range(n):
        cur += float(logits[r])
        if cur > best:
            best = cur
            best_start = start
            best_end = r
        if cur < 0:
            cur = 0.0
            start = r + 1

    if best <= 0.0:
        idx = int(np.argmax(logits))
        return idx, idx

    return int(best_start), int(best_end)


def decode_span(text, logits):
    if len(logits) == 0:
        return text
    s, e = select_span(logits)
    pred = text[int(s) : int(e) + 1].strip()
    if not pred:
        pred = text
    return pred


def jaccard(str1, str2):
    a = set(str1.lower().split())
    b = set(str2.lower().split())
    if not a and not b:
        return 1.0
    inter = a.intersection(b)
    union = a.union(b)
    return len(inter) / len(union)


def compute_jaccard(true_list, pred_list):
    scores = [jaccard(t, p) for t, p in zip(true_list, pred_list)]
    return float(np.mean(scores))


def run_training(model, loader, epochs):
    model.train()
    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=LR, weight_decay=1e-5)
    for _ in range(epochs):
        model.train()
        for batch in loader:
            char_ids, word_ids, sent_ids, pos_ids, lengths, labels = [
                x.to(device) for x in batch
            ]

            optimizer.zero_grad()
            logits = model(char_ids, word_ids, sent_ids, pos_ids)
            mask = (char_ids != 0).float()
            loss = nn.functional.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(
                logits, labels, reduction="none"
            )
            loss = (loss * mask).sum() / mask.sum().clamp(min=1.0)
            loss.backward()
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
            optimizer.step()


def predict_logits(model, loader):
    model.eval()
    results = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in loader:
            char_ids, word_ids, sent_ids, pos_ids, lengths = [
                x.to(device) for x in batch
            ]
            logits = model(char_ids, word_ids, sent_ids, pos_ids)
            for i in range(char_ids.size(0)):
                L = int(lengths[i].item())
                results.append(logits[i, :L].float().cpu().numpy().copy())
    return results


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Load data
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_CSV)
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_CSV)

train_texts = train_df["text"].astype(str).str.strip().tolist()
test_texts = test_df["text"].astype(str).str.strip().tolist()
train_selected = train_df["selected_text"].astype(str).str.strip().tolist()
train_sentiments = train_df["sentiment"].astype(str).str.strip().tolist()
test_sentiments = test_df["sentiment"].astype(str).str.strip().tolist()

sent2id = {"positive": 0, "negative": 1, "neutral": 2}
train_sent = np.array([sent2id[s] for s in train_sentiments], dtype=np.int64)
test_sent = np.array([sent2id[s] for s in test_sentiments], dtype=np.int64)

# Build vocabularies
char_counter = Counter()
word_counter = Counter()
for text in train_texts + test_texts:
    char_counter.update(text)
    word_counter.update(w.lower() for w in text.split())

char_vocab = {"<pad>": 0, "<unk>": 1}
for ch, _ in char_counter.most_common():
    if ch not in char_vocab:
        char_vocab[ch] = len(char_vocab)

word_vocab = {"<pad>": 0, "<unk>": 1}
for w, _ in word_counter.most_common(VOCAB_MAX):
    if w not in word_vocab:
        word_vocab[w] = len(word_vocab)

UNK = 1


def encode_tweet(text, selected_text=None):
    text = text[:MAX_CHARS]
    L = len(text)

    char_ids = np.zeros(MAX_CHARS, dtype=np.int64)
    word_ids = np.zeros(MAX_CHARS, dtype=np.int64)
    pos_ids = np.arange(MAX_CHARS, dtype=np.int64)

    for i, ch in enumerate(text):
        char_ids[i] = char_vocab.get(ch, UNK)

    for m in re.finditer(r"\S+", text):
        s, e = m.start(), m.end()
        e = min(e, MAX_CHARS)
        wid = word_vocab.get(m.group().lower(), UNK)
        word_ids[s:e] = wid

    for i in range(L):
        if word_ids[i] == 0:
            word_ids[i] = UNK

    if selected_text is None:
        return char_ids, word_ids, pos_ids, L

    labels = np.zeros(MAX_CHARS, dtype=np.float32)
    sel = selected_text.strip()
    if sel:
        start = text.find(sel)
        if start == -1:
            start = text.lower().find(sel.lower())
        if start != -1:
            end = start + len(sel)
            end = min(end, MAX_CHARS)
            labels[start:end] = 1.0

    return char_ids, word_ids, pos_ids, L, labels


# Encode train
N = len(train_texts)
train_chars = np.zeros((N, MAX_CHARS), dtype=np.int64)
train_words = np.zeros((N, MAX_CHARS), dtype=np.int64)
train_pos = np.zeros((N, MAX_CHARS), dtype=np.int64)
train_labels = np.zeros((N, MAX_CHARS), dtype=np.float32)
train_lengths = np.zeros(N, dtype=np.int64)

for i, (text, sel) in enumerate(zip(train_texts, train_selected)):
    c, w, p, L, lab = encode_tweet(text, sel)
    train_chars[i] = c
    train_words[i] = w
    train_pos[i] = p
    train_lengths[i] = L
    train_labels[i] = lab

# Encode test
N_test = len(test_texts)
test_chars = np.zeros((N_test, MAX_CHARS), dtype=np.int64)
test_words = np.zeros((N_test, MAX_CHARS), dtype=np.int64)
test_pos = np.zeros((N_test, MAX_CHARS), dtype=np.int64)
test_lengths = np.zeros(N_test, dtype=np.int64)

for i, text in enumerate(test_texts):
    c, w, p, L = encode_tweet(text)
    test_chars[i] = c
    test_words[i] = w
    test_pos[i] = p
    test_lengths[i] = L

# Tensors
train_chars_t = torch.tensor(train_chars)
train_words_t = torch.tensor(train_words)
train_pos_t = torch.tensor(train_pos)
train_labels_t = torch.tensor(train_labels)
train_lengths_t = torch.tensor(train_lengths)
train_sent_t = torch.tensor(train_sent)

test_chars_t = torch.tensor(test_chars)
test_words_t = torch.tensor(test_words)
test_pos_t = torch.tensor(test_pos)
test_lengths_t = torch.tensor(test_lengths)
test_sent_t = torch.tensor(test_sent)

test_dataset = TensorDataset(
    test_chars_t, test_words_t, test_sent_t, test_pos_t, test_lengths_t
)
test_loader = DataLoader(test_dataset, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=False)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Cheap candidate probe
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
set_seed(SEED)
rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED)
probe_idx = rng.choice(N, size=1024, replace=False)

probe_loader = DataLoader(
    TensorDataset(
        train_chars_t[probe_idx],
        train_words_t[probe_idx],
        train_sent_t[probe_idx],
        train_pos_t[probe_idx],
        train_lengths_t[probe_idx],
        train_labels_t[probe_idx],
    ),
    batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
    shuffle=True,
)

probe_model = CharSpanTagger(len(char_vocab), len(word_vocab)).to(device)
run_training(probe_model, probe_loader, epochs=1)

probe_logits = predict_logits(probe_model, test_loader)
probe_preds = [
    decode_span(text, logits) for text, logits in zip(test_texts, probe_logits)
]

probe_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {"textID": test_df["textID"].astype(str), "selected_text": probe_preds}
)
atomic_write_df(probe_df, "candidate_probe.csv")

with open("candidate_probe.csv", "rb") as f:
    probe_bytes = f.read()
atomic_write_bytes(probe_bytes, "submission.csv")

probe_sha = sha256_file("candidate_probe.csv")
print(
    f"CANDIDATE_PROBE_READY elapsed_s={time.time() - START:.1f} sha256={probe_sha}",
    flush=True,
)

del probe_model, probe_logits, probe_loader
torch.cuda.empty_cache()

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Full 5-fold CV + test ensemble
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
folds = list(
    StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED).split(
        train_chars_t, train_sent
    )
)

test_logits_sum = [
    np.zeros(min(len(text[:MAX_CHARS]), MAX_CHARS), dtype=np.float32)
    for text in test_texts
]

all_true = []
all_pred = []

for fold, (tr, va) in enumerate(folds):
    set_seed(SEED + fold)

    model = CharSpanTagger(len(char_vocab), len(word_vocab)).to(device)

    train_loader = DataLoader(
        TensorDataset(
            train_chars_t[tr],
            train_words_t[tr],
            train_sent_t[tr],
            train_pos_t[tr],
            train_lengths_t[tr],
            train_labels_t[tr],
        ),
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        shuffle=True,
    )

    val_loader = DataLoader(
        TensorDataset(
            train_chars_t[va],
            train_words_t[va],
            train_sent_t[va],
            train_pos_t[va],
            train_lengths_t[va],
        ),
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        shuffle=False,
    )

    run_training(model, train_loader, EPOCHS)

    val_logits = predict_logits(model, val_loader)
    fold_true = [train_selected[i] for i in va]
    fold_pred = [decode_span(train_texts[i], lg) for i, lg in zip(va, val_logits)]

    all_true.extend(fold_true)
    all_pred.extend(fold_pred)

    fold_test_logits = predict_logits(model, test_loader)
    for i, arr in enumerate(fold_test_logits):
        test_logits_sum[i][: len(arr)] += arr

    del model, train_loader, val_loader, val_logits, fold_test_logits
    torch.cuda.empty_cache()

cv_score = compute_jaccard(all_true, all_pred)

final_preds = []
for i, text in enumerate(test_texts):
    logits = test_logits_sum[i] / len(folds)
    final_preds.append(decode_span(text, logits))

final_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {"textID": test_df["textID"].astype(str), "selected_text": final_preds}
)
atomic_write_df(final_df, "submission.csv")

full_sha = sha256_file("submission.csv")
print(
    f"FULL_CANDIDATE_READY elapsed_s={time.time() - START:.1f} sha256={full_sha}",
    flush=True,
)
print(f"FINAL_VALIDATION_SCORE: {cv_score:.6f}", flush=True)
